definition:
flowchart LR
  A[Producer] ==> B{Broker}
  B -.->|retry| C[Consumer 1]
  B -->|primary| D[Consumer 2]
  B --x E[Dropped]
  D --o F[Ack store]
  C --> F
  F --> |flush every 5s| G[(Warehouse)]
  linkStyle 1 stroke:#ff8800,stroke-width:2px
  linkStyle 3 stroke:#aa0000,stroke-width:2px
intent: flowchart with directional edge variants, linkStyle, and edge label text on curved links
